sections.label: Effect
sections.text: If the defector's mentor is in the area, the mentor burns with flame until the end of the defector's next turn. While this fire burns the mentor has fire immunity 10, and any creature who targets the mentor with a strike takes 10 fire damage.

sections.label: Effect
sections.text: The area burns with infernal fire until the end of the devil's next turn. Any enemy of the defector who ends their turn in the area takes 10 fire damage, and if they have P < AVERAGE they are [frightened](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/frightened) ([save](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.general/saving-throw) ends).
